title: Fix the Uninitialized Variable
description: The program should double a number and print the result.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 5 (starting from 0 and adding 5).
actualProblem: result is declared but never given an initial value before it's read on the right-hand side of the assignment, so the compiler reports 'variable result might not have been initialized'.
explanation: Java requires local variables to be definitely assigned a value before they are read, unlike instance fields which get automatic defaults. Declaring int result; alone leaves it without a usable value.
